## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Vibrant Spaces?
D41, 4th Street, Anna Nagar East, Chennai 600 102.

### What facilities does Vibrant Spaces have?
Full home interiors, Modular kitchens, Wardrobes, Luxury interiors, Bespoke furniture, Pooja units, Construction, Renovation, Commercial interiors, Landscape, Online design studio.

### Is there a warranty?
Yes, Vibrant Spaces gives a 5-year warranty on woodwork.

### How are payments staged?
A 10% retainer for 3D drawings and a final quote, 40% to start, 45% before completion and the last 5% once you are satisfied.

### How do I book a design consultation with Vibrant Spaces?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 95431 95431.
